text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Just as I finished packing up to head 
home, the visitor I had made a promise 
with long ago appeared.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text: Hello, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text: Dad! You came!

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course. So, I was hoping we could 
talk about—

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Mmm...! I smell the wind. To think a place 
like this was so close to the racecourse.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
I haven't been a Trainer all these years 
for nothing. This place is my secret 
hidden gem.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer-san. Watching today's race, I 
somehow felt an overwhelming sense of 
relief.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Because C.B. was running the race with 
such a bright, cheerful expression.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"CB is overflowing with talent. She's 
certainly capable of claiming glory on the 
biggest stages."

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
But if that's all it was, then... that 
wouldn't really be "Mr. C.B."

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Untrapped by anything, bound by nothing. 
Because CB is an Umamusume freer than 
anyone else.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"Even today, if CB wasn't satisfied in the 
slightest, she probably would've 
complained about even entering the race."

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha... Well, maybe so. I might just end 
up saying 'pass'.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Still, because I wanted to run in it, we 
chose this race.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"If your girl starts running races outside 
her aptitudes, those around you will 
surely criticize you both."

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
Still, as a parent, that's perfectly fine 
with me. As long as C.B. can run true to 
herself like today, that's more than 
enough.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, I see. So that's how my races 
looked to you.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
"That is why, without any exaggeration, I 
truly believe you were the right choice to 
be my daughter's Trainer."

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
For our daughter to truly be "Mr. C.B.", 
she needs you.

text_block_list.name: C.B.'s Father
text_block_list.text:
A Trainer who respects my daughter's 
wishes and places your trust in her. That 
is who you are.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It happened after we parted ways with her 
father, as Mr. C.B. and I were walking 
back.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you asked your dad 'Please come watch 
my race!' before, right?

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
You know, back then, I'm sure Dad was 
really happy.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
No matter how earnestly Dad asked for her 
hand in marriage, Mom's family refused to 
accept it.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
So when Trainer showed sincere dedication, 
maybe they saw their own reflection in 
that.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
"It showed us just how earnestly you're 
treating our daughter."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
If that's the case, I don't want to let my 
parents down. What I can do for that sake 
is—
choice_data_list: I'll keep supporting you from now on.
I'll keep supporting you from now on.

text_block_list.name: Mr. C.B.
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, thanks. I'm going to run in my own 
way, so make sure you follow me wherever I 
go.
